title: GreedyGamble
description: This mod adds two types of enchantments: gambler coins and lucky enchantments and bad luck enchantments that can be enchanted on it.
body:
This mod adds gambler's coins and two enchantments: Luck and Misfortune, which can be applied to them.

```[Core Elements]```

Gold is a weapon added by this mod

Without enchantment, each attack has a 50% chance to deal fatal damage to the target and a 50% chance to deal fatal damage to oneself. Lucky enchantment increases the probability of directly dealing fatal damage to the target to 75%. Lucky enchantment reduces the probability of directly dealing fatal damage to the target to 25%

[Simple Introduction] This mod adds gold coins and two enchantments: Luck and Misfortune, which can be applied to them.

【Core Elements】

The golden weapon was added by this mod

Without enchantment, each attack has a 50% chance to deal lethal damage to the target and a 50% chance to deal lethal damage to oneself. Lucky Enchantment increases the probability of directly dealing lethal damage to the target to 75%
Reduces the chance to deal critical damage to the target by 25%
